name: Barr Hill Gin
production: Juniper distilled in a custom-built botanical extraction still
Raw honey added as a finishing touch
history: 2019 | Forbes review of top gins lists Barr Hill first
palate: Soft wildflower notes from the honey
expressions: Barr Hill Tom Cat Gin | Old Tom gin in the Barr Hill line
serve_official: Retailer suggests neat on the rocks, gin & tonic, or Bee's Knees
notes: Flagship of Caledonia Spirits; described on Wikipedia as top-selling Vermont-made spirit and 'most awarded gin made in the US'. Raw honey said to carry an estimated 100-115 pollen and plant particles. Company founded by Todd Hardie, originally in Hardwick; Ryan Christiansen is president and head distiller.
